QuestInfo.name: [Luna Crystal] Formal and Frosty
QuestInfo.0: Wisp wants to talk to you. What could it be about??
QuestInfo.1:
Equip all 3 Frosty Friends pets, then return to Wisp.
You must equip the #rPetite Luna Pets born from the Luna Crystal#k before you go.

#b#e[Frosty Friends Set]#k#n\r\n#e[Pet]#n#i5002785#   #t5002785##i5002786#   #t5002786#\r\n#e#n#i5002787#   #t5002787#
QuestInfo.2: You brought all of the Frosty Friends pets and got a gift from Wisp.

0.msg: Hello, #b#h0##k! It's good to see you.

1.msg: Same here. It's been a while.

2.msg: I wanted to asked, have you ever seen a castle purely made from ice? They say it holds a magical secret too.

3.msg: I've never heard of it. That sounds cool, though! What else do you know about it?

4.msg: Why don't you take a look for yourself? Beautiful, isn't it?#k\r\n#i3802069#

5.msg: If you show me all the pets from the #e#bFrosty Friends set#k#n, I'll invite you to see the #i3019534##b #t3019534##k.\r\n#r(This event is a quest that can only be completed once per world.)
